question: What is the compound interest on Rs. 24,000 for 2 years at the rate of 10% per annum, if interest is compounded annually?
solution:
Given:

Principal amount = Rs. 24000

Rate of interest = 10% p.a. 

Time = 2 years

Concept used:

One year of compound interest on a certain sum of money is equal to the one-year of simple interest on the same amount.

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI
